Class Piece

java.lang.Object
Piece
Direct Known Subclasses:
Cat, Dog, Elephant, Leopard, Lion, Rat, Tiger, Wolf
public class Piece extends Object
Represents an animal piece and its corresponding name and strength These pieces are moved around the board and can capture another player's pieces

    • beInWater

      public boolean beInWater()
      Determines whether the piece can be in water or not
      Returns:
      false by default as only the rat piece can be in water. The rat class overrides this method.

    • canCrossLake

      public boolean canCrossLake()
      Determines whether the piece can cross the lake or not
      Returns:
      false by default as only the panthera (tiger and lion) pieces can cross the lake. The panthera class overrides this method.
